title: Error envelope
description: Every non-200 outcome. `additionalProperties: false` is load-bearing: an error can never carry an `assessment`, `decision` or `scan_status`, so no failure path can present itself as a clean scan. A caller that receives this must not continue to translation under the example enforcement policy.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Maps to an HTTP status; see contracts/openapi.yaml. Clients branch on this, never on the message text.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Must never echo the passage, an evidence quote, a credential or a raw prompt.

retry_after_seconds.description: Present on rate_limited and may be present on overloaded.
